what_it_pays_for: The platform pays you directly for hitting performance targets it sets, usually on reels, during a limited campaign. Money comes from the platform rather than from viewers or advertisers.
additional_requirements_not_assessed: Must have a professional account (business or creator).
Must meet the Partner Monetization Policies.
Must live in a country where bonuses are being tested.
Invitations are issued by the platform and include an element of random selection, so no public number predicts one.
